Gc: Workstation, default tiered JIT, fresh process per case, no warmup
TimingMetric: Lazy row generation, FillStreaming and output file close; excluding template preparation and validation
MemoryMetric: OS peak working set over the entire process including preparation and validation
Input: Lazily generated per-task dictionaries; 4 unique text fields, decimal, date per 6 columns; original single-row prototype
Validation: Streaming XML verification of every cell address, type, style index and value; row/cell totals and last row
